worldcombat.skill.echoedvoice.summary: Sing a voice that lingers in the air: it strikes one target with sound and leaves that echo layer behind; while a nearby echo is still ringing, anyone who sings next can build on it, for power = base x layer (1-5). Sound ignores cover, and the tighter the chain, the heavier it lands.
worldcombat.skill.echoedvoice.use.0: Sing an echo that lingers in the air
worldcombat.skill.echoedvoice.use.1: Build on a nearby echo and stack it higher
worldcombat.skill.echoedvoice.use.2: Name a target with sound that ignores cover
worldcombat.skill.echoedvoice.descriptio: Hits one non-ally target for about %1$s special (Normal, sound) damage.

Every cast leaves a layer of echo on the singer for %3$s; within an earshot of %2$s blocks, if any echo (your own included) is still ringing, this voice builds one layer on the strongest echo, making this cast layer %1$s (up to 5).
Current: Crescendo — earshot x1.2 and echo duration x1.35 to keep the chain alive, but your own voice x0.94.
Current: Solo — base x1.08, earshot x0.85 and duration x0.8, so one voice can still ring loud.
worldcombat.skill.echoedvoice.timing: Range %1$s blocks, prepare %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.echoedvoice.growth.0: At level %1$s the base voice power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.echoedvoice.growth.1: At level %1$s the base voice power rises to %2$s and the echo lasts to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.echoedvoice.preference: On: earshot x1.2 and echo duration x1.35 to keep the chain alive, but your own voice x0.94. Off: Solo — base x1.08, earshot x0.85 and duration x0.8, so one voice can still ring loud.
Only sing when the target is within this distance; raise it to pick up an echo from farther away.
On: priority goes to building on an echo carried by yourself or a nearby ally; off: rank it as an ordinary ranged move.
